document: Universal Mobile Control — Audited Batch Chronology

audit_basis.rule: Current source is authoritative for implementation facts. Historical runtime evidence is retained but is not promoted to current PASS unless the current runtime is freshly verified.

events: AccessibilityService selected as the practical control layer.
Termux MCP -> local HTTP bridge -> AccessibilityService architecture established.
Screen observation designed around accessibility UI tree, screenshot and OCR.
MainActivity and VisionAccessibilityService are part of the project.
Local bridge is bound to 127.0.0.1:8765.
UI elements expose text/description/bounds and interaction state.
Latin and Devanagari OCR are implemented.
UniversalMobileControl-debug.apk was produced.
Version recorded as 0.1.0.
Historical project record reports Gradle 8.13.
chronology.limitation: The APK file timestamp alone does not prove the installed AccessibilityService revision.

events: Earlier screen tests used 1080x2400 coordinates.
Accessibility UI data and OCR were used to locate controls.
chronology.correction: 1080x2400 must not be treated as a permanent coordinate system; rediscover the current screen on every fresh scan.

events: Current bridge exposes health, screen, scan, Action Mode, tap, swipe, back and type endpoints.
Home is not implemented as a bridge endpoint.
/screen is cached and /scan is asynchronous.
Application-level errors can still be returned with HTTP 200.
Historical editable Ask anything node was located around bounds 313,1865 to 1049,1957.
Tap around 680,1910 was dispatched.
Keyboard/focus change was not independently verified.
chronology.correction: Dispatch or HTTP success is not equivalent to verified target activation.

events: An earlier request used start_x/start_y/end_x/end_y and failed because x1 was missing.
The current bridge format is x1,y1,x2,y2 with optional duration.
Back uses GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK and was user-confirmed working in an earlier test.
Home endpoint was previously reported as unknown and remains absent from current source.
chronology.correction: Do not claim a /home bridge command until it is implemented and runtime-tested.

events: Tap and swipe use GestureResultCallback.
CountDownLatch and AtomicReference distinguish completion, cancellation and timeout.
A dedicated UMC-GestureCallbacks HandlerThread is used.
chronology.audit_note: A callback timeout proves only that completion/cancellation was not observed within the configured wait period; it does not by itself prove that no gesture reached the target.

events: canPerformGestures=true.
canRetrieveWindowContent=true.
canTakeScreenshot=true.
Required interactive-window/view-id accessibility flags are present.
chronology.correction: Configuration proves declared capability, not current service activation or successful target UI change.

events: Latest known recorded tap test returned tap callback timeout.
Latest known recorded swipe test returned swipe callback timeout.
possible_causes: Current APK/service revision may not be the revision being exercised.
Accessibility Service may need disable/re-enable after installation.
Gesture callback delivery may still be failing.
Concurrent scan/OCR work may interfere with action verification.

events: Historical README records Home -> app drawer -> native YouTube -> search -> video selection -> ad handling -> playback verification.
The recorded final state included visible playback controls and video metadata.
chronology.correction: Retain as historical evidence only; do not use it as proof of the currently installed revision.

events: Action Mode starts OCR immediately and schedules refreshes every 3000 ms.
tap/swipe start Action Mode before dispatching the gesture.
Manual scan and periodic scan can therefore overlap the action lifecycle.
No single-flight scan guard is currently present.
chronology.correction: Dispatch the action first, then perform a controlled post-action scan; serialize or guard scan execution.

events: Gesture callback HandlerThread is stopped in onDestroy.
OCR executor is not explicitly shut down in onDestroy.
Local bridge thread/server has no explicit service-lifecycle stop mechanism.
chronology.correction: Add deterministic executor shutdown and bridge/server cleanup during service destruction.

events: Prior chronology was rechecked against the available current-batch audit evidence.
Unsupported PASS claims were not promoted.
Historical results were explicitly separated from current-runtime proof.
Verification requirements were tightened to require fresh post-action UI evidence.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe completion is not currently proven by the latest recorded runtime tests.
audit_findings.correction: Require gesture callback completion/cancellation and a fresh post-action scan proving the expected UI state before PASS.

audit_findings.finding: Historical YouTube success conflicts with the fact that the current installed revision is not proven and later gesture tests timed out.
audit_findings.correction: Keep historical evidence but require a current-build retest.
Implement a single-flight scan guard or serialized scan queue.

audit_findings.finding: tap/swipe start Action Mode before dispatch.
audit_findings.correction: Separate action dispatch from verification refresh.

audit_findings.finding: New ML Kit recognizers are created per scan.
audit_findings.correction: Reuse long-lived recognizers and close them on service destruction.
Optionally invalidate cached state from relevant accessibility events.
Implement GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME endpoint only if required, then test it separately.

audit_findings.finding: APK artifact does not prove installed-service provenance.
audit_findings.correction: Record exact APK hash/version, install it, disable/re-enable Accessibility Service, then retest.
Explicitly shut down the executor in onDestroy.

audit_findings.finding: Bridge lifecycle is not explicitly tied to service destruction.
audit_findings.correction: Retain server/thread references and close/interupt them during destruction.

truth_table./tap: IMPLEMENTED; current runtime completion requires retest.
truth_table./swipe: IMPLEMENTED; current runtime completion requires retest.
truth_table./type: IMPLEMENTED through focused editable AccessibilityNodeInfo; current effect not independently verified in this audit.
truth_table.HTTP_200: NOT sufficient proof of action success.

verification_protocol.level_4: Fresh post-action scan proves the intended UI state.
verification_protocol.final_rule: Only level 4 counts as fully verified.

confirmed: Accessibility-based screen/control architecture exists in the audited source.
Screenshot, UI-tree and OCR observation are implemented.
Gesture capability and dedicated callback HandlerThread are configured.
Back implementation exists and had an earlier user-confirmed test.
Historical native YouTube playback is documented.
not_currently_proven: Reliable tap completion in the currently installed runtime.
Reliable swipe completion in the currently installed runtime.
That the historical YouTube PASS belongs to the currently installed APK/service revision.
next_validation_gate: Promote to PASS only when the intended UI change is actually visible.
